resources.string: Operation failed. Check the details, storage access and connection.

Only connect to devices you are authorised to manage. SSH uses the standard Android route, including VPN. Up to 4 sessions; connections remain open in the background for up to 5 minutes, then close. Android may terminate them earlier.
Terminal: a custom VT subset, ANSI/256 colours, alternate screen and 5000 history lines. Full xterm compatibility, wide characters and combining Unicode are not yet guaranteed.
Profiles exported without passwords, keys or secret references.
SSH storage cannot be read. Existing data is preserved.
Delete profile %1$s and its saved password?
Close the SSH connection and remove this tab?
Connect to %1$s? The configured command will run after login: %2$s
Without a saved password you will be prompted on connection. An empty field preserves the saved password when saving remains enabled.
First create or import a key under Keys.
Enter a name, host and username. Port 1–65535; no control characters. The startup command runs automatically after you confirm connection.
Secret protection: Android Keystore / StrongBox / AES-256-GCM.
Secret protection: hardware Android Keystore / AES-256-GCM.
Secret protection: software Android Keystore / AES-256-GCM; hardware is unavailable.
Ed25519, ECDSA and RSA of at least 3072 bits are supported. Private keys are stored encrypted; passphrases are not saved. Remove a key from profiles before deleting it.
Delete private key %1$s? This cannot be undone.
Forget the host key for %1$s? All sessions will close. Verify the fingerprint independently on the next connection. A change may indicate a MITM attack.
Verify this fingerprint through an independent trusted channel. Accept only if it belongs to the intended server.
Connection is blocked. This may be a MITM attack or a key replacement. After independent verification you can forget the old key in Trusted hosts; this dialog never accepts a changed key.
Send text does not send Enter. Use Ctrl/Alt with one character; Enter and other keys have separate buttons.
Control characters and newlines will become spaces. Text goes into the input field; send it and press Enter separately.
